mapper.select: SELECT id, event_type, aggregate_id, payload, status, retry_count, next_retry_time, processing_time, processing_token, publish_time, last_error, created_time, updated_time FROM outbox_event WHERE status = 0 AND next_retry_time <= #{now} ORDER BY next_retry_time, id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE outbox_event SET status = 1, processing_token = #{processingToken}, processing_time = #{processingTime}, updated_time = #{processingTime} WHERE status = 0 AND id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, event_type, aggregate_id, payload, status, retry_count, next_retry_time, processing_time, processing_token, publish_time, last_error, created_time, updated_time FROM outbox_event WHERE status = 1 AND processing_time IS NOT NULL AND processing_time <= #{cutoff} ORDER BY processing_time, id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
